name: Vighnesh Iyer
headline: Where cinematic vision meets *user experience*.
intro: I'm Vighnesh — a product designer who spent 3.5+ years building worlds for Hollywood films before moving into UI/UX. I bring that dimensional, detail-obsessed way of seeing to B2B, SaaS and fintech products.
tagline: Where cinematic vision meets user experience. Bringing 3D visualisation expertise to UI/UX design.
